name: The Stack
description: The Stack is a 3.1 TB dataset of permissively licensed source code across 30 programming languages, designed to support research on large language models for code understanding and generation. It includes a permissively licensed subset and tools for code search and removal requests, facilitating open and responsible research.
reputation: Widely used in code LLM research as one of the largest open permissively licensed code corpora, especially for pretraining and code understanding studies.
notes: Includes near-deduplication to boost performance; matches HumanEval and MBPP performance using only permissively licensed data.
